home_faq_pickup_q: How does laundry pickup and delivery work?
home_faq_pickup_a: Book online, on WhatsApp or by phone. We collect your laundry from your home at the time you choose. Then we bring it back clean, folded and ready to wear. Pickup and delivery are always free.
home_faq_duration_a: Your clothes are usually ready within 24–72 hours. Need them sooner? Ask about our 24-hour express service.
home_faq_delicates_q: Do you clean suits and special clothes?
home_faq_delicates_a: Yes. We carefully clean suits, boubous, kabas, party clothes and wedding dresses one by one. Dry cleaning starts at 2 500 XAF, while the price for other special items depends on the fabric and care needed. We treat stains carefully, then iron or steam your clothes to finish.
home_faq_allowance_q: What if I use more than my plan?
home_faq_allowance_a: Extra clothes are charged at our normal price, per piece or per kilo, whichever is cheaper for you. We always tell you before you pay more.
home_faq_damage_a: If we damage something, we repair or replace it. And if you are not happy with the cleaning, we clean it again for free.
home_faq_moreAfter: — a real person replies in minutes.
home_cta_title: Let’s handle your laundry this week.
home_cta_lead: Book now. We can come as early as tomorrow morning.

home_faq_cost_q: How much does laundry cost in Douala?
home_faq_cost_a: Wash & fold starts at 700 XAF per kg, with a 5 kg minimum. Wash, dry & iron is 1 000 XAF per kg, with a 3 kg minimum. Per-piece washing starts at 700 XAF for adults and 200 XAF for children. Dry cleaning starts at 2 500 XAF. Pickup and delivery are free. Use the price check above to see your price.
home_faq_area_q: Do you cover my area in Douala?
home_faq_area_a: Yes. We cover all of Douala, and pickup and delivery are free wherever you are in the city.
home_faq_bedding_q: Do you clean bedsheets and curtains?
home_faq_bedding_a: Yes. We clean bedsheets, duvets, curtains and pillowcases, from 1 500 XAF. Some monthly plans include bedsheets and curtains too.
home_faq_shoes_q: Do you clean shoes and sneakers?
home_faq_shoes_a: Yes. We clean, whiten and freshen sneakers and leather shoes, from 2 000 XAF per pair.
